name: Dimensional Pull, Greater
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level arcanist 8, psychic 8, sorcerer 8, summoner 6, witch 8, wizard 8
Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like the dimensional pull, except you can teleport the creature to any chosen, empty space within the spell’s range. This stout, horned demon is engulfed in flames. Its massive hands are almost as threatening as the roaring ball of flame it has drawn from its very body.
